dialogues.speaker: Kazim
dialogues.text: The longer I work at this job, the more I come to think that everything should be planned out in advance, with contingencies to match.

dialogues.speaker: Kazim
dialogues.text: I'm very grateful to the Village Keepers for their aid, but we can't always rely on them.

dialogues.speaker: Kazim
dialogues.text: Preventing problems before they can occur is the safest way to go about things.

dialogues.speaker: Kazim
dialogues.text: That applies to you, too, I believe. There are always times when we need to do some repairs outdoors, so take this — better safe than sorry.
